answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 18 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in dune, queued in spiral, and ledge publishes the wait time. A farm of 171 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3691 identities would post 1752 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
